title: One verb, six directions
caption:
One verb, six directions: prefixes turn идти́ into arrive, leave, cross and more.
прийти́ = arrive, уйти́ = leave, вы́йти = go out, зайти́ = drop in, перейти́ = cross, подойти́ = approach.
Which prefix do you mix up? Save this cheat sheet.
